variable_coverage.construction: Raw inputs: I/B/E/S quarterly actual EPS and period/announcement dates for loss, earnings-change and earnings-surprise thresholds.; Stock price at the beginning of quarter t, which deflates quarterly earnings levels, t-versus-t−4 changes and forecast surprises.; CRSP daily firm and market returns plus earnings announcement dates used to form three-day market-adjusted CARs and exclude the two extreme CAR percentiles from the main firm-quarter sample.; CRSP SIC classifications used to exclude regulated industries (SIC 4400–5000) and financial firms (SIC 6000–6500) from the main sample.; Historical link from I/B/E/S ticker/CUSIP/firm-quarter records to CRSP PERMNO for the beginning-quarter price, SIC and market-adjusted sample-return screen.. Construct Standardized difference: avoid quarterly losses as SDiff_avoid-loss,y = (Observed_left_bin_y − Expected_left_bin_y) / EstimatedSD(Observed − Expected); Expected_left_bin_y = mean(counts in adjacent bins); counts rescaled to N=1,000.. Source definition: Burgstahler–Dichev standardized difference for the avoid-loss threshold (quarterly earnings level deflated by beginning-of-quarter-t stock price) in year y, evaluated in the earnings bin just left of zero. It is the actual observation count minus the expected count, divided by the estimated standard deviation of that difference; the expected count is the average of the two adjacent bins. The authors compute the threshold-year statistic using a standardized N of 1,000 based on the actual bin proportion. Bins have width .0025. A negative value indicates threshold achievement; |statistic| ≥ 2.33 is the stated one-tailed threshold criterion.. Exact current-vintage field-to-paper mapping limitations are recorded on the linked routes and in review notes.
